title: Loss of Recordings, Unsynced Devices, and Unresponsive Customer Support
body: I subscribed to Notee: AI Note Taker and was initially impressed by the summaries it generated after meetings. However, because I have an Apple iPhone and a tablet, I logged into my account on this platform, expecting—like with all other apps—that it wouldn’t be a problem as a single user. I had no issues accessing the Notee app or using it to record. Since I was using different devices, I expected that during an update, they would show recordings from both devices. The next day, I checked each device and realized the recordings had not synchronized across both devices, and all recordings were missing from the tablet, the second device I used. I tried to send an in-app message from the tablet, but even though I had a subscription and was logged in, the feature was grayed out. I decided to email support from my iPhone, explaining the problem. It's been a week since my initial message. I followed up with another message, but I still haven't received any response. Unfortunately, this results in a loss of irreplaceable high-level content, with consequences that cannot be recovered. My advice is to have a backup method for AI note-taking. The technology is still new and cannot be relied on fully. Also, luckily, my trial was only a weekly subscription.

title: A lifeline for memory and accountability
body: Notee has become one of the most helpful tools I use. When I’m dealing with stressful, inappropriate, or overwhelming situations, it helps me capture what was said, turn audio into text, and summarize the important points so I do not have to rely on memory in the moment. For anyone dealing with trauma, high-stress communication, advocacy, or documentation, this app is incredibly valuable. Sometimes you cannot remember everything clearly until later, especially when your nervous system is overwhelmed. Notee helps preserve the facts, organize the details, and make the information easier to review. It also works beautifully hand-in-hand with ChatGPT. Notee helps me capture and summarize the information, and then ChatGPT helps me organize, clarify, and turn it into something useful. This app has genuinely helped me feel more prepared, grounded, and heard. Highly recommend.

title: Worth Every Penny!
body: I have used this app in multiple situations when I know I will need to reference an accurate record of a discussion. We use it for recording our RPG sessions, and because we often go several weeks between sessions. With Notee, I can pull up the notes from the prior session to give a “Previously on…” summary. Also, my husband and I often recall important conversations differently, but with Notee, we can go back to the summary or transcription to *know* what we said. This is especially helpful with our marriage counselor because we can share the files with her to help us with communication assumptions and distorted thoughts. We’ve also used it when in important meetings about major purchases or when we want to be sure there is an accurate record of the meeting to avoid future false accusations, etc. At $39.99/year, Notee is definitely worth every single cent!
